boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Stevenson study environments across the library and Learning Commons, with noted access constraints.

cards.title: Open Group Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Philip A. Zaffere Library, Owings Mills North
cards.notes: Bring a project group to the library’s open group-study areas, then use nearby library research support when your team needs a source check.
cards.short_summary: An open setting for collaborative coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson identifies open group study areas among the Philip A. Zaffere Library’s study-space options.
cards.source_title: Philip A. Zaffere Library | Stevenson University
cards.access_notes: Located at Owings Mills North. Follow current library access rules and posted hours.

cards.title: Reservable Collaborative Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Philip A. Zaffere Library, Owings Mills North
cards.notes: Reserve a collaborative room before a meeting-heavy assignment, and leave time to set up materials and divide the work once your group arrives.
cards.short_summary: Bookable rooms for focused group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says the Zaffere Library includes reservable rooms for collaborative work.
cards.source_title: Philip A. Zaffere Library | Stevenson University
cards.access_notes: Room reservation is required; verify availability and current library access rules before going.

cards.title: Quiet Individual Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Philip A. Zaffere Library, Owings Mills North
cards.notes: Choose a quiet individual pod when you need to read closely or draft alone; bring headphones if your work includes audio.
cards.short_summary: A quieter individual-study option inside the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson lists quiet individual study pods among the Zaffere Library’s available spaces.
cards.source_title: Philip A. Zaffere Library | Stevenson University
cards.access_notes: Located in the Zaffere Library; follow current library access rules and posted hours.

cards.title: Traditional Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Philip A. Zaffere Library, Owings Mills North
cards.notes: Set out notebooks, readings, and a laptop at a traditional table for a longer independent session with room to organize your materials.
cards.short_summary: Table seating for independent study materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson lists traditional tables for independent study in the Zaffere Library.
cards.source_title: Philip A. Zaffere Library | Stevenson University
cards.access_notes: Located in the Zaffere Library; follow current library access rules and posted hours.

cards.entity_name: Chip Rouse Computer and Media Room
cards.title: Chip Rouse Computer and Media Room
cards.subtitle: Philip A. Zaffere Library, Owings Mills North
cards.notes: Use the room’s computer workstations for research or coursework that needs campus hardware, then save files to your own storage before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Library computer workstations for coursework and research.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson identifies computer workstations in the Chip Rouse Computer and Media Room at the Zaffere Library.
cards.source_title: The Philip A. Zaffere Library is Open and Ready to Welcome Stevenson Students, Faculty, and Staff
cards.access_notes: Located in the Zaffere Library; confirm current computer and library access policies before use.

cards.title: Library Computer Workstations
cards.subtitle: Philip A. Zaffere Library, Owings Mills North
cards.notes: Use a library workstation when you need immediate access to research tools and coursework; plan to log out fully when you finish.
cards.short_summary: Campus computers distributed through the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson states that computer workstations are available throughout the Zaffere Library for research tools and coursework.
cards.source_title: Philip A. Zaffere Library | Stevenson University
cards.access_notes: Located throughout the Zaffere Library; follow current library access rules and posted hours.

cards.title: MacDonald Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Manning Academic Center, Owings Mills North
cards.notes: Use this flexible library space for collaborative work or interdisciplinary research, especially when your assignment benefits from working alongside classmates.
cards.short_summary: A flexible Library space for collaboration and research.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson describes the Learning Commons in the Manning Academic Center as a library location supporting collaborative work and interdisciplinary research.
cards.access_notes: In the Manning Academic Center. Confirm building and Learning Commons access before visiting.

cards.title: Learning Commons Computer Teaching Lab
cards.subtitle: MacDonald Learning Commons, Manning Academic Center
cards.notes: Check whether the computer teaching lab is available before planning computer-based work there, since it may be used for library instruction.
cards.short_summary: A computer-equipped room within the Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson’s catalog identifies a computer teaching lab as a feature of the Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: Availability may be constrained by instruction; confirm current Learning Commons access before visiting.

cards.title: Learning Commons Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: MacDonald Learning Commons, Manning Academic Center
cards.notes: Coordinate with classmates before using a Learning Commons study room, and check current room procedures so your group has a confirmed workspace.
cards.short_summary: Three study rooms in the Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson’s catalog states that the Learning Commons features three study rooms.
cards.access_notes: In the Learning Commons; verify current room-use procedures and building access before going.

cards.title: Learning Commons Presentation Practice Room
cards.subtitle: MacDonald Learning Commons, Manning Academic Center
cards.notes: Use the presentation practice room to rehearse a class talk aloud, test your pacing, and make final notes before your scheduled presentation.
cards.short_summary: A designated room for presentation rehearsal.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson’s catalog identifies a presentation practice room in the Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: In the Learning Commons; confirm current room-use procedures and building access before visiting.

warnings: Library and room access can change; verify current availability and posted building hours before visiting.
